_comment: Trims godot-cpp's generated bindings from ~1000 engine classes to the
handful this extension links against. Build goes from ~10 min to ~1 min,
and the .so from megabytes to kilobytes.
RefCounted is BladeSolverNative's base. The rest are not ours: they are
what godot-cpp's own src/ and include/ include unconditionally, so
dropping any of them fails the build with a missing godot_cpp/classes/
header rather than anything about the blade. Base classes are pulled in
Adding a Godot class to the C++ solver? Add it here too.
